sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Greater Powerful is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Applies a stronger Powerful.

sections.title: How to Get Greater Powerful
sections.content: Location: Sirene - Crumbling Path merchant past the handholds, 37,100 Chroma.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
